mainEntity.name: How much does a Mercedes Viano 3.2 or 3.7 V6 engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Viano 3.2 or 3.7 V6 engine replacement typically costs between £2,000 and £3,800 depending on condition type and whether fitting is included. M112 V6 units range from £2,000 to £3,800 supply only. Rebuilt M112 (Viano 3.2 / 3.7 V6): £2,000-£3,800 supply only. Reconditioned units: £1,600-£3,000. Used engines from breakers: £800-£2,200 but higher risk. Labour for supply & fit adds £400-£800 to any engine price.

mainEntity.name: Is the M112 V6 engine in the Viano 3.2 and 3.7 reliable?

acceptedAnswer.text: The M112 V6 is fundamentally a smooth and refined engine, but it has several well-documented weak points as mileage climbs. Head gasket degradation - composite gasket design prone to coolant-oil mixing. Oil leaks from camshaft plugs (30mm and 65mm) and rocker cover gaskets. Thermostat failure causing temperature fluctuations. With preventative maintenance, these engines can exceed 150,000-200,000 miles.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of M112 head gasket failure in a Viano 3.2 or 3.7 V6?

acceptedAnswer.text: The M112's head gaskets typically show warning signs before complete failure. Coolant loss with no visible external leak. Oil in the coolant expansion tank (may appear milky or as a film). White smoke from the exhaust. Engine overheating or temperature fluctuations. Loss of power and rough running.

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my Viano 3.2 or 3.7 V6 engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repair if the failure is isolated (e.g., head gaskets, oil leaks, thermostat). Replace if there's bottom end damage, bore scoring, or warped cylinder heads. Head gasket replacement with MLS gaskets: £1,200-£1,800 - permanent fix. Rocker cover gasket replacement: £250-£450 - excellent preventative maintenance. Thermostat replacement: £150-£300 - do this at first sign of temperature fluctuation. Full M112 rebuild: £2,200-£3,800 - for catastrophic failure or 120k+ miles. Given Viano 3.2 / 3.7 V6 values (£3,000-£8,000), a rebuilt engine is typically good value.

mainEntity.name: How do I know which engine code my Viano 3.2 or 3.7 V6 has?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check your vehicle log book (V5C) for the engine number, which includes the engine code prefix. V5C log book shows full engine number with code prefix. Engine code stamped on cylinder block. Viano 3.2 V6 (2003-2008): M112.951 (190hp). Viano 3.7 V6 (2005-2010): M112.970 (235hp). Service history documents list engine type.

mainEntity.name: Can I fit a used Viano 3.2 or 3.7 V6 engine myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: We strongly advise against DIY fitting on a Viano 3.2 or 3.7 V6. The M112 V6's weight, W639 subframe geometry, and ECU coding requirements demand specialist equipment and expertise. V6 engine weight requires proper lifting equipment. Subframe must be lowered - not a driveway job. ECU coding and immobiliser synchronisation required. Specialist supply & fit costs £400-£800 - essential for a V6.

historyTimeline.h2: Mercedes Benz Viano 3.2 V6 / 3.7 V6 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The Mercedes Benz Viano 3.2 V6 and 3.7 V6 represented the premium petrol options in the W639 Viano range, powered by the M112 family of 18-valve SOHC V6 engines. While rare in the UK market - petrol Vianos account for under 10% of sales - these smooth, refined units offered effortless power delivery at the cost of significant fuel consumption【10†L30-L31】.

milestones.description: W639 Viano launched with M112.951 3.2L V6 petrol, 190hp (140kW), 270Nm torque, 5-speed automatic transmission
M112.970 3.7L V6 petrol introduced as a special-order option, 235hp (175kW), 350Nm torque
M112 3.2L V6 discontinued as M272 3.5L V6 replaced it in facelift models
M112 3.7L V6 production ends as facelift Viano range transitions to M272 petrol units

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every M112 V6 petrol engine fitted to the Mercedes Benz Viano 3.2 and 3.7 is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points from real owner experience【1†L19-L20】.

commonProblems.h2: Mercedes Benz Viano 3.2 V6 / 3.7 V6 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Mercedes Viano 3.2 V6 and 3.7 V6 rely on the M112 V6 petrol engine - a smooth and refined unit that delivers effortless power, but has developed a well-documented reputation for predictable failures as mileages climb. Head gasket degradation, oil leaks from camshaft plugs, and thermostat failures are the most frequently cited issues【10†L20-L21】. Every rebuilt engine supplied through EnginesMarket includes upgraded components designed to address the original failure point - plus a minimum 12-month unlimited mileage warranty. Below we break down the most common Viano 3.2 and 3.7 V6 engine failures, what they cost to fix, and when replacement is the smarter financial decision.

problems.h4: M112 Head Gasket Failure - Why the Viano 3.2 / 3.7 V6 Loses Coolant and Mixes Oil
problems.rootCause: The M112 V6 uses a composite head gasket design that is prone to degradation over time, particularly if the engine has been overheated. Coolant can leak into the oil galleries or oil into the cooling system, leading to overheating, loss of performance, and eventual engine damage【10†L20-L21】.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace head gaskets with MLS (multi-layer steel) upgraded gaskets, pressure test heads, new bolts
repairOptions.longevity: 80k-150k miles; permanent fix with upgraded gaskets

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit reconditioned M112 with new head gaskets, timing components, and seals
repairOptions.longevity: Full long-block warranty. Required if overheating has warped cylinder heads

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Viano 3.2 or 3.7 V6 is worth £3,000-£8,000 depending on condition and mileage - the full replacement cost of £2,200-£3,800 is modest relative to vehicle value for most examples. For vehicles worth under £3,000, evaluate repair options first.
problems.recommendation: If you notice coolant loss without an external leak, oil in the coolant, or white smoke from the exhaust, have the head gaskets inspected immediately. Specialist head gasket replacement with MLS upgraded gaskets (£1,200-£1,800) is a permanent fix - use a specialist who has experience with M112 engines and can fit the updated MLS gaskets rather than OEM composite units.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt M112 engine prices for your Viano 3.2 / 3.7 V6

problems.h4: M112 Oil Leaks - Why the Viano 3.2 / 3.7 V6 Drips Oil
problems.rootCause: The M112 V6 is prone to oil leaks from multiple locations - camshaft plugs (30mm and 65mm), rocker cover gaskets, and oil cooler seals. These leaks are common on higher-mileage examples and can lead to oil loss, belt contamination, and eventual engine damage if ignored【10†L20-L21】.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace rocker cover gaskets, new spark plug tube seals

repairOptions.tier: Camshaft Plug & Oil Cooler Seal Replacement
repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace camshaft plugs (30mm and 65mm) and oil cooler seals
Supply & fit reconditioned M112 with new gaskets, seals, and upgraded components
repairOptions.longevity: Full long-block warranty. For catastrophic failure

problems.vehicleValueCheck: On a Viano 3.2 or 3.7 V6 worth £3,000-£8,000, rocker cover gasket replacement at £250-£450 is excellent preventative maintenance. Full engine replacement is only justified for catastrophic failure.
problems.recommendation: Oil leaks on the M112 are rarely urgent but should not be ignored - oil dripping onto the exhaust manifolds can create smoke and, in extreme cases, fire risk. The specialist camshaft plug and oil cooler seal replacement (£350-£650) addresses the most common leak points in one go, saving on labour versus doing each repair individually.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt M112 Mercedes Viano 3.2 / 3.7 V6 engine prices

problems.h4: M112 Thermostat & Cooling System Failure - Why the Viano 3.2 / 3.7 V6 Overheats
problems.rootCause: The map-controlled thermostat can fail, causing temperature fluctuations and potential overheating. The cooling system on the M112 is critical to engine longevity - overheating can accelerate head gasket failure【10†L21】.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace map-controlled thermostat, flush cooling system, replace coolant
Replace thermostat, water pump, radiator hoses, full system flush
Supply & fit reconditioned M112 with new cooling system components
repairOptions.longevity: Full long-block warranty. Required if overheating has caused damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: On a Viano 3.2 or 3.7 V6 worth £3,000-£8,000, thermostat replacement at £150-£300 is excellent value. Full engine replacement is only necessary if overheating has caused head gasket or bottom end damage.
problems.recommendation: The M112's map-controlled thermostat is a known weak point - if you notice the temperature gauge fluctuating or the engine taking too long to warm up, replace the thermostat immediately. On higher-mileage examples, a full cooling system refresh (£350-£650) is recommended to prevent overheating-related head gasket failure.
